answers.text: "break came on day_vol 1.34, under the 1.40 bar" - 1.40 is O'Neil's line, not my test. My C5/R3 test: rvol_20d >= 1.0 = genuine-looking break; R6 sign-of-strength needs >= 1.2. rvol_20d 1.31 clears both. H1 96% of the day's range = top-third close; W 9>21, HH/HL, 0.7% under 20-wk high = weekly frame up (C16). Lens coil is another engine's read. The break stands until a daily close back under the Creek.

"new-high break came on day_vol 1.26, under 1.40" - my R3 test is rvol_20d >= 1.0, R6 >= 1.2: 1.26 clears both, a modest-volume caution I already filed, not an upthrust. H1 81% of the day's range keeps the close in the top third; D HH/HL, 0.5% under 20-day high; W 9>21. Sector rank is not a Wyckoff test. I am wrong on a daily close back under structure_shift_ref 95.37.
